title: 高松宮記念の後に・奮い立て

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Neither King nor I win the Takamatsunomiya Kinen… But King is still proud of her decision to remain true to herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells me to take pride in being myself without worrying about what anyone else thinks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I must stop being afraid of hurting others and behave in a way that's true to myself! I decide to participate in the talk show at the Fan Fest as a way to show my conviction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's scary, of course, but I have someone by my side who reassures me that I'm not alone!
